training_basic_desc: This course is designed for complete beginners with no prior experience. You will learn everything from the basics to application on a model.

training_basic_welcome_title: Become a lash stylist in just 2 days and start your career in the beauty industry
training_basic_welcome_desc_1: I invite you to an individual eyelash extension course where you will master professional techniques, learn to create beautiful applications, and gain all the necessary knowledge to start working in the field of eyelash extensions.
training_basic_welcome_desc_2: During the training, we cover classic eyelash extensions as well as the basics of 2D, 3D, and „wet effect“ volume techniques.
training_basic_welcome_desc_3: During the practical part on a model, one of the techniques is performed — classic eyelash extensions or the popular „wet effect“, which is currently in high demand among clients.
training_basic_welcome_desc_4: The training is conducted in an individual format, which is the most effective way to master this profession.
training_basic_welcome_desc_5: I give each student my full attention, thoroughly demonstrating each step of the work, sharing professional tips, and helping to avoid the most common mistakes.
training_basic_welcome_desc_6: My goal is for you to feel confident after completing the course and be able to start working with clients.
training_basic_benefit_2_title: 2. Courses led by a qualified instructor with over 9 years of experience
training_basic_benefit_6_title: 6. All materials and tools are available during the course
training_basic_benefit_7_title: 7. Support even after completing the course

privacy_policy_6_desc: The data subject has the right to access their personal data, rectify or erase it, as well as the right to object to its processing. They also have the right to lodge a complaint with the Office for Personal Data Protection of the Slovak Republic.
privacy_policy_7_desc: Personal data is not provided to third parties or transferred to third countries outside the European Union.
privacy_policy_8_desc: These personal data protection policies are valid and effective from the date of their publication on the website.
